headline: Excelsior leak goals, Fortuna create little
summary: Excelsior arrive in Sittard without a win in 5 Eredivisie games and with 15 goals conceded in that run, including a 0-4 defeat at Heerenveen last week. The obvious read is a home win — but Fortuna create very little, 0.77 expected goals a game, and their home form has been shaky: they lost 1-5 to Ajax in September. Even so, Excelsior's run makes Fortuna narrow favourites at 39.4%, up from 35.5% a few days ago. The market expects about 3.0 goals.
read: Fortuna Sittard host Excelsior on Sunday as narrow favourites, about 39%, against a side without a win in five and shipping three goals a game.

facts.fact: Fortuna Sittard are narrow favourites at 39.4%, with Excelsior close behind on 34.8%.
Fortuna's chance has risen from 35.5% to 39.1% in recent days, while Excelsior drifted from 39.3% to 34.9%.
facts.meaning: The two sides have swapped places in the market — the home team is now the favourite in a game it was not favoured in a few days ago.

facts.fact: The goal line sits at 3.0, with Over and Under each priced at 50%.
facts.meaning: The market sees an open game: three goals is the even-money point, a high line for a match between two mid-table sides.

facts.fact: Excelsior are without a win in five Eredivisie matches (LLDLD).
facts.meaning: The away side arrives as the team out of form, with two points from that run and no clean sheet in it.

facts.fact: Excelsior have conceded 15 goals across those five league games.
facts.meaning: They have shipped three per game on average, and a Fortuna side short on creation will still fancy its chances.

facts.fact: Fortuna were out-created 3.06 to 0.45 in expected goals at NEC on Sunday.
facts.meaning: Their point came from goalkeeping and finishing rather than control — the home side gives up far more than it creates.

facts.fact: Fortuna average just 0.77 xG per game over their last five matches.
facts.meaning: The favourites create very little; their position in the table is built on efficiency and goalkeeping, so this is a game they may have to grind out.

facts.fact: Fortuna lost 1-5 at home to Ajax on 12 September, conceding 4.13 xG.
facts.meaning: Sittard has already been taken apart at home this season, so home advantage is not a guarantee of control.

sources.fact: Fortuna Sittard drew 2-2 away at NEC Nijmegen, with Anthony Descotte opening the scoring in the 18th minute.
Goalkeeper Mattijs Branderhorst played a crucial role in the closing stages against NEC, including saving a penalty.
Branderhorst said he has mixed feelings about the NEC result given his own decisive late contribution.
L1 Nieuws notes that Fortuna's league campaign continues at home on Sunday against Excelsior.
Fortuna's website was among several Dutch club sites pulled offline over a critical software flaw.
